comments.overrides: expo-audio's loose range on expo-asset lets npm resolve the SDK 57 build into this SDK 54 app, which expo-doctor flags as a duplicate native module. Pin both to their SDK 54 versions. Revisit if the SDK is ever bumped.
comments.audit: npm audit reports ~12 high / ~12 moderate, all inside the Metro and @expo/cli build toolchain (metro, metro-config, image-size, postcss, xcode, uuid). None of it ships in the app binary — the exposure is the dev server and `expo export`, i.e. someone feeding hostile input to the bundler. Every advertised fix resolves to SDK 57, which breaks Expo Go on the target device; see the SDK pin note in CLAUDE.md. Accepted deliberately: don't run the dev server against untrusted branches or third-party assets. Re-run `npm audit` when the SDK pin lifts and expect most of these to clear.
